traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The lesser marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other
magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text:
The lesser marilith’s weapon attacks
are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The lesser marilith makes three attacks
with its longsword and one attack with its tail.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one
creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the
target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC
14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained,
the lesser marilith can automatically hit the target
with its tail, and the lesser marilith cannot make tail
attacks against other targets.
